answer_text: The maximum number of levels for constructions à destination principale d'habitation under UMG Article 10.2 is R+5 (c-01)[avec un nombre de niveaux limité à R+5]. The same bullet caps height at 20 metres for this use (c-02)[la hauteur maximale des constructions est limitée à 20 mètres]. Source: printed page 325, PDF page 326.
additional_context: The planner rationale says R+5 can be the binding constraint. The text sets R+5 and 20 m together in one bullet, so both apply cumulatively, but it does not say which one binds for a given building. The text does not define R+5 beyond the notation itself. Article 10.2 also opens with a general compatibility clause with the OAP (pièce n°3), which may impose further limits that were not checked here.

citations.claim: Zone UMG Article 10.2 limits constructions à destination principale d'habitation to R+5 levels.
citations.verification_instructions: TEXT | plu_reglement | page=325 (printed; PDF page 326) | quote='avec un nombre de niveaux limité à R+5'
citations.reasoning: plu_reglement PDF page 326 (printed p. 325), section 10.2 'REGLE GENERALE', reads: 'Pour les constructions à destination principale d'habitation : la hauteur maximale des constructions est limitée à 20 mètres, avec un nombre de niveaux limité à R+5.' The quoted phrase 'avec un nombre de niveaux limité à R+5' appears verbatim, and it sets the R+5 level limit for habitation in zone UMG (Moulon - UMG header on the page).

citations.claim: Zone UMG Article 10.2 limits the maximum height of constructions à destination principale d'habitation to 20 metres.
citations.verification_instructions: TEXT | plu_reglement | page=325 (printed; PDF page 326) | quote='la hauteur maximale des constructions est limitée à 20 mètres'
citations.reasoning: Same passage, PDF page 326 (printed p. 325), section 10.2: 'la hauteur maximale des constructions est limitée à 20 mètres' appears verbatim under the habitation destination bullet. The page is the UMG zone regulation, so the 20 m limit for habitation applies as the claim states. Article 10 also says projects must be compatible with the OAP, but that does not change the stated 20 m limit.
